sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Home Hydroponics and Gardening Equipment

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English common law and French civil law traditions received at independence in 1980, with customary (kastom) law recognised under the Constitution; company and commercial legislation follows the Commonwealth statute-based pattern.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force for Vanuatu
World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreements – Vanuatu acceded in 2012

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 9 of 2014 (as amended); Company and Trust Service Providers Act No. 20 of 2013; Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organised Crime Act [Cap. 293]; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Beneficial Ownership Directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the valid passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or Commissioner for Oaths in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Contracting States; otherwise Consular Legalization at the appropriate Vanuatu diplomatic/consular mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or banking institution; certified by a notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming account opening and good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate or personal bank of the applicant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Forwarded directly by the issuing bank to the licensed registered agent; apostille/consular legalization required where mandated by VFSC practice for the origin jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency or certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization in accordance with the origin jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (or equivalent constitutive documents) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate shareholder's registered agent or competent registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as above

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence under the AML/CFT Act 2014 and VFSC AML/CFT Rules; all directors, shareholders, signatories and UBOs screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Vanuatu domestic designations under the Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organised Crime Act [Cap. 293], FATF public statements and high-risk jurisdiction lists, OFAC SDN List, and EU restrictive measures; positive PEP matches require senior management approval and ongoing transaction monitoring by the licensed registered agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – electronic company name search and reservation facility; applications must be routed exclusively through a licensed registered agent under the Company and Trust Service Providers Act 2013.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be rendered in the Latin alphabet using English or French transliteration; Bislama names are acceptable if transliterated into Latin script. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme' or a permitted abbreviation ('Ltd', 'Corp', 'Inc.', 'SA'). Punctuation, special characters and non-Latin scripts are not permitted.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banking / Banker – prior written FSC consent and banking licence required
Insurance / Assurance / Reinsurance – licensed activity, prior FSC consent required
Trust / Trustee / Trust Company – licensed activity, prior FSC consent required
Securities / Stock Exchange / Investment / Fund / Mutual Fund – licensed activity, prior FSC consent required
Credit Union / Co-operative – reserved by statute
University / Chartered – prior ministerial or professional body approval required
Government / Ministry / National / Crown / Royal – state patronage implied, prohibited or restricted
Offshore – restricted where it falsely implies a specific regulatory status
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection the licensed registered agent must obtain the written reason from the VFSC Registrar. A rectified name may be re-filed within 7 days without a further government fee. For an adverse determination, a written administrative appeal may be submitted to the VFSC Registrar within 21 days of the notice; if dismissed, the applicant may seek a formal statement of reasons and thereafter apply for judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. A fresh reservation with a materially different name may be concurrently filed through the registered agent. An existing reservation may be extended for one further 30-day period provided the extension request is lodged before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable – a statutory registered office maintained at the premises of a licensed registered agent satisfies the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; a remote management and virtual back-office structure is permissible for a non-resident e-commerce IC operating the online retail of garden hydroponics equipment, provided the IC does not carry on business with persons in Vanuatu, does not own land in Vanuatu, and does not require a Vanuatu business licence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – approximately 5% annualized probability for a low-risk standard non-resident e-commerce IC; unannounced VFSC inspections under the AML/CFT Act 2014 and Company and Trust Service Providers Act 2013 are principally focused on the licensed registered agent's premises, CDD files and UBO records rather than the foreign beneficial owner's premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation application fee (submitted via licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of incorporation registration fee under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation fee per the International Companies Act and VFSC Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service – Year 1 (company file, statutory registers, regulatory correspondence, name clearance administration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Company and Trust Service Provider (CTSP)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a non-resident e-commerce International Company

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register setup, AML/CFT customer due diligence onboarding, and PEP/sanctions screening – Year 1
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per VFSC AML/CFT Rules and the CTSP compliance manual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and/or consular legalization of identity and address bundles for the director and UBO (two principal sets)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent apostille authority in the country of origin; Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs for consular legalization route
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff and statutory apostille/legalization fees per document set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence and UBO heredity opinion (Stage 1 scope)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External offshore counsel engaged by the registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee market benchmark; covers corporate structure review, UBO identity verification, and tax-status assessment

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of Vanuatu (as amended), Part II (incorporation and constitution), Part III (powers and duties), and Part V (registered office and registered agent); International Companies Regulations 1993.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 – Application for Registration of an International Company, together with the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement; the company may issue one or more shares of no par value and may remain with nil paid-up capital until the subscriber approves an allotment
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by sole subscriber and first director, that: (1) the subscription for 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value is approved and allotted to the subscriber for no premium or contribution; (2) the registered office shall be situated at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu; (3) the subscriber is appointed first director and the named officer is appointed company secretary, each authorized to open bank accounts, maintain statutory registers, and execute filings; (4) the licensed registered agent is instructed to complete all post-incorporation formalities and pay all applicable fees. This resolution is effective immediately upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Verify eligibility and reserve corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission via a VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request to the VFSC through the licensed registered agent. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Vanuatu company, must not imply a regulated banking, trust, insurance, or fiduciary activity unless separately licensed, and must include 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or an approved abbreviation.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and name reservation form
Copy of subscriber's passport or national identity card
Proof of residential or business address of subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, the subscriber may submit up to three alternative names through the agent; if a conflict is found, a formal request for VFSC discretionary approval may be filed with a supporting explanation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute memorandum and articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscriber and incoming director before a notary public; countersigned by the VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber must execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, stating the proposed name, registered office address, registered agent details, share capital structure, and objects clause permitting the online retail of home hydroponics and gardening equipment. Each director and officer must sign a consent to act. The registered agent certifies that all statutory requirements are met.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as first director
Consent to act as company secretary or officer
Notarized authorization if subscriber is a corporate entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or notary identifies a defect in execution, the subscriber must re-execute the deficient page or document; if VFSC later queries a clause, a corrective written resolution may be adopted and the amendment filed before formal incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File application for incorporation with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies and International Trusts Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent electronically or physically lodges Form 1 – Application for Registration of an International Company together with the signed constitution, notices of directors and officers, registered agent consent, and payment of the government filing fee. Upon successful vetting, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The company comes into existence on the date shown on the certificate.
required_dossiers: Consents to act of each director and officer
Proof of payment of VFSC filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is placed under query, the registered agent must provide the requested corrections or supplementary declarations within 14 calendar days. If the application lapses, a fresh Form 1 may be refiled after curing the identified deficiencies; additional fees may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt first board resolution and allot initial shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First director and sole subscriber; records maintained by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after the Certificate of Incorporation is received, the first director executes the written pro-forma board resolution. The resolution approves the allotment of no-par-value shares, fixes the registered office, records the appointment of officers, and authorizes the opening of corporate bank accounts. The registered agent then enters the share allotment and appointments into the company's statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Consents to act as director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the statutory registers are incorrect or incomplete, the first director must pass a corrective written resolution and the registered agent must amend the registers immediately; late filing penalties to VFSC may be avoided by prompt cure before any regulatory inspection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete VFSC annual registration formalities and facilitate bank account activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; licensed offshore bank and payment-rail providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the initial notice of directors and officers, if applicable, and reconciles the initial government fee. The company then submits a standard account-opening package to a licensed bank or e-money institution that supports Stripe and PayPal payout flows. Copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, beneficial ownership statement, and source-of-funds declaration are provided in accordance with VFSC anti-money-laundering requirements.
required_dossiers: Bank account application and source-of-funds declaration
Business plan and projected payment volumes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises KYC queries, the company must promptly supply updated passport copies, corporate registers, and a detailed source-of-funds narrative; if VFSC raises an annual filing discrepancy, the agent must resubmit the correct declaration within the statutory cure period to avoid penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no manufacturing, warehousing, or physical industrial establishment is created in Vanuatu; the entity operates as a restricted International Company conducting offshore e-commerce only
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no operating or manufacturing permit is required for online retail of home hydroponics and gardening equipment conducted from outside Vanuatu's domestic market

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards and Environment, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical project, construction, discharge, or resource extraction in Vanuatu; no environmental impact assessment or registration is required for a cross-border e-commerce scope
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to pure online retail. If a future physical distribution hub is established, the operator must comply with Vanuatu's Waste Management Act, trade-waste discharge standards, and e-waste handling requirements for obsolete electronic equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — the International Company does not occupy premises or employ staff physically in Vanuatu. If a representative office or storage facility is later established, fire safety certification, structural load inspection, and workplace occupational health clearance must be obtained from the Vanuatu Fire Service and the Department of Labour before operations begin.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRCS), an agency of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu; registration services are available at VRCS offices in Port Vila and Santo, with no fully integrated national digital taxpayer portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities making taxable supplies in Vanuatu must apply to VRCS for VAT registration using Form VAT-01, accompanied by certificate of incorporation, proof of business address, bank account details, expected taxable turnover, and a statement of intended compliance with the Value Added Tax Act. Upon approval, VRCS issues a unique VAT registration number. International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act are exempt from national direct taxes and therefore do not require an income tax registration number; however, VAT registration remains compulsory if the statutory turnover threshold is met or if the entity imports goods into Vanuatu on a continuing basis.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax and no capital gains tax; therefore, no check-the-box elections or hybrid-mismatch elections are available. The International Companies Act grants an unconditional statutory tax exemption for international companies, subject only to indirect tax (VAT and customs duties) registration and compliance obligations where triggered.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246] of Vanuatu
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 of taxable turnover in any consecutive 12-month period
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate exists in Vanuatu. There is no mandatory API-based e-invoicing system, no pre-clearance tax stamping, and no continuous transaction control regime. Registered persons must issue VAT invoices that satisfy the statutory content rules under the Value Added Tax Act; both paper and electronic VAT invoices are accepted provided they contain all required particulars and are supported by underlying accounting records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of goods exported from Vanuatu are eligible for zero-rating under the Value Added Tax Act, provided the supplier obtains and retains documentary evidence that the goods left Vanuatu within the statutory timeframe and that the recipient is outside Vanuatu. Services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Vanuatu may also qualify for zero-rating where they are performed overseas or directly in connection with exported goods. For online sales of garden hydroponics equipment, zero-rating is available only where the equipment is physically shipped from Vanuatu to a foreign destination and all export formalities are completed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusEx/Export Entry) approved by Vanuatu Customs
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice describing the goods, quantity, value, and HS tariff classification
Proof of export timing, including port/airport departure stamps and shipping carrier records
Foreign inward remittance certificate or bank settlement statement evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs may subject export zero-rating claims to enhanced document verification. Where a zero-rated export is unsupported by the mandatory documentation bundle, or where fraud or misrepresentation is established, VRCS may retroactively assess VAT at 12.5% on the gross supply, impose a penalty of up to 50% of the assessed tax, and charge statutory default interest from the date the VAT became due. Criminal prosecution for fraudulent export VAT claims may result in fines up to VUV 2,000,000 and/or imprisonment. Retrospective VAT assessments generally extend to all supplies within a four-year limitation period, with no cap where fraud is proven.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) administers exchange control under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 75] and regulates authorized dealers; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licenses and supervises International Companies. The Vatu (VUV) is issued by the RBV and managed against a weighted basket of the currencies of Vanuatu's major trading partners.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations: the VUV is fully convertible for current account payments and transfers with no government approval required. The capital account is liberalized for non-residents; a Vanuatu International Company (IC) is statutorily treated as non-resident and exempt from the Exchange Control Act, permitting unrestricted retention of export proceeds, unlimited holding of USD/AUD/NZD/EUR accounts, and unimpeded repatriation of dividends, interest, and loan principal. No profit-remittance hurdles or withholding taxes apply to an IC. Practical friction is limited to the thin offshore VUV market: daily liquidity is shallow, bank spreads on VUV crosses are wide, and material treasury flows should therefore be kept in USD to avoid conversion drag.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must repatriate export proceeds to an authorized dealer within six months of shipment and comply with RBV surrender directives. International Companies are exempt from surrender and repatriation obligations under the exchange-control exemption in the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; all online retail receipts may be retained offshore in hard currency with zero mandatory conversion to VUV, provided the entity maintains valid IC status and a non-resident treasury function.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account (USD primary; VUV now-account for incidental local costs)
Operational current account in USD/VUV with SWIFT and internet banking
Operational account in USD or VUV with corporate internet banking

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Major global EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Airwallex) do not support direct onboarding of a pure Vanuatu IC with VUV capability. EMIs that accept Pacific offshore structures typically require a regulated parent guarantee, a fully disclosed e-commerce business, and impose transaction-perimeter limits. The EMI route is feasible only as a secondary settlement wallet for PSP payouts (Stripe via a merchant-of-record or payment facilitator, and PayPal) while the primary treasury ledger remains a Tier-1 Vanuatu bank account; sole reliance on an EMI is not advisable.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permitted; directors are not required to appear physically in Port Vila. Banks mandate a video or teleconference interview with the compliance officer and typically require a professional introduction from a VFSC-licensed registered agent. Standard remote package: certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles, Certificate of Good Standing, registered agent certificate, board resolution appointing signatories, notarized passports, proof of residential address, beneficial ownership schedule matching the VFSC register, 12-month business plan with projected volumes, and a banker's reference from the shareholder's home-country bank. Onboarding duration is 4 to 8 weeks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IC presenting no demonstrable economic substance in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC company profile and good standing certificate; registered agent certificate; beneficial ownership schedule; substance letter (inventory drop-ship, web-hosting, marketing, support functions); live storefront URL; supplier and platform agreements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors or beneficial owners connected to a zero-tax jurisdiction without provable source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized passports; utility and address proofs; criminal background certificates from country of residence; three months of personal bank statements; CVs and corporate registration documents of all beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inward settlement flows arriving from third-party PSPs (Stripe/PayPal) rather than named counterparty accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PayPal and Stripe merchant agreements; payout schedules; reconciliation statements mapping PSP settlements to order-level e-commerce records; platform KYC evidence of merchant identity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid in-out fund movements resembling an unlicensed money service business or sanctions transit profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier purchase orders; logistics invoices with tracking and proof of delivery; minimum balance covenant; annual volume forecast; board resolution restricting account use to ISIC 4791 e-commerce clearing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire protocol: inbound SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the IC's Tier-1 USD operational account. Remittance line must state 'Share Capital Subscription - [IC Name], VFSC Company No. ###' or 'Shareholder Loan Disbursement - Intercompany Agreement dated [date]'. ISO 20022 purpose code: INTC (Intercompany Payment) for shareholder loans or CORP (Corporate Payment) for equity subscription. No RBV pre-approval or exchange-control permit is required. Verification bundle for the receiving bank: certified board resolution, subscription or loan agreement, source-of-funds statement, and the remitter's bank statements evidencing three-month provenance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Open-account trade settlements use SWIFT MT103 with invoice references. Commercial documentary Letters of Credit (MT700) are preferred for bulk hydroponics component purchases (LED grow lights, pumps, nutrient dosing units). LC document set: signed commercial invoice, full set of clean on-board Bills of Lading or AWB, packing list, certificate of origin, and pre-shipment inspection certificate when required. Retail-side clearing: Stripe (via supported-jurisdiction merchant-of-record or payment facilitator) and PayPal sweep proceeds to the IC's USD clearing account on daily reconciliation; outbound supplier settlements remain in USD until the ultimate invoice date to avoid VUV conversion, except for Vanuatu domestic costs paid from the VUV now-account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV forward contracts with RBV-licensed authorized dealers (tenor 1 week to 12 months; 10% initial margin typical for non-resident ICs)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/VUV with offshore counterparty banks where no onshore VUV balance is held
Cross-currency swaps USD/VUV with onshore authorized dealers, subject to bilateral credit limits and ISDA 2002 CSA documentation
USD/AUD, USD/NZD, and USD/EUR deliverable forwards and swaps for hedging supplier and PSP settlement currency mismatches

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Public Fee Renewal for International Company (annual government license payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the incorporation anniversary month; registered agent invoices before the anniversary; payment must clear by month-end of the anniversary month, with a 30-day grace period before late penalties accrue.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment penalty accrues after the grace period; continued non-payment for 90 days permits VFSC strike-off action; struck-off International Company may be dissolved and its assets forfeited to the State.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Confirmation (agent declaration of statutory registers and beneficial ownership records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted annually in conjunction with the renewal fee and within 60 days following each incorporation anniversary; UBO and share register updates filed immediately upon any transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-lodgement constitutes an offence under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; administrative fines apply to the registered agent and the Commission may suspend the company's good standing and progress to strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Tax-Exemption Status Attestation (confirmation of no Vanuatu domestic business activity and continued eligibility for the statutory 20-year tax exemption)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and Vanuatu Department of Finance (Tax Office) record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Reviewed annually during the registered agent's KYC refresh on the anniversary; updated within 21 days of any share transfer or director change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or untruthful attestation invalidates the International Company's exempt status for that year, exposing the company to domestic income tax assessment at standard Vanuatu rates and late-filing administrative penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit applies to a standard unlicensed International Company; mandatory only if the company holds a VFSC financial services licence (dealing/investment/insurance) or the Commission issues a direct written audit direction; dormant e-commerce trading of hydroponics equipment does not trigger an audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory local GAAP prescribed for International Companies; books must sufficiently disclose financial position and record transactions at the registered office; IFRS recommended for online marketplace revenue recognition and future conversion.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The VFSC-licensed registered agent must obtain and continuously maintain beneficial ownership information; annually the agent confirms to VFSC the accuracy of member, director and controller details; any share transfer or change of controller is reported to the agent within 21 days and the statutory registers are updated at the registered office immediately; the annual agent confirmation is the sole public verification mechanism because share registers of International Companies are not open to public inspection.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,200 per annum for a VFSC-licensed registered agent inclusive of registered office, secretarial compliance and government-fee handling
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - 3,000 per engagement for a voluntary certified review or audit; no statutory audit fee is mandatory for an unlicensed International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate. International Companies are statutorily exempt under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) from all Vanuatu taxes, including corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding taxes. Income derived by the VU_IC from online retail sales of hydroponics and gardening equipment to overseas customers is treated as offshore income: no CIT, no business licence tax on offshore trading, and no VAT on exports.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return — Form 12 under Section 48 of the International Companies Act (Cap 222), filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry Online Portal (www.vfsc.vu). No corporate income tax return is required.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within one month following each anniversary of incorporation, filed by the registered agent electronically through the VFSC portal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and International Company (IC) registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exact registered name; non-resident directors need appoint the Vanuatu registered agent to verify the incorporation certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, address, and VFSC licence number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent completes this box; no non-resident data required.
A Vanuatu physical address (typically the agent's office) must be listed; PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital and class of shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State total authorised shares in VUV or USD as recorded at establishment; non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors list: full name, nationality, residential address, passport number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Submit scanned passport pages and notarised proof of address; no physical presence in Vanuatu is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders list: full legal name, ownership percentage, and ultimate beneficial owner details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all natural-person beneficial owners via the agent for AML/CFT compliance; foreign corporate shareholders must provide a structure chart.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of no local business: confirmation that no trade was conducted with Vanuatu residents and no leasehold freehold property held in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a director; a foreign director may execute via power of attorney in favour of the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Location of accounting records and financial statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records may be kept outside Vanuatu but the location must be disclosed and the records must be accessible to the agent on demand.
May be any date chosen by the board; default 31 December is acceptable for an offshore e-commerce entity.
The Vanuatu registered agent signs and attests that the IC has continued to satisfy its offshore status obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of VUV 10,000 imposed by the VFSC; persistent default triggers strike-off from the corporate register under Section 55 of the International Companies Act, loss of legal personality, and inability to enforce contracts until restoration. Directors remain personally liable for company debts arising during the period of non-compliance if the company is wound up.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double tax treaty network, so no DTA withholding relief protocol is invoked. No Tax Residency Certificate can be issued to an IC because the company is wholly tax-exempt. Outbound dividend distributions, including annual distributions of accumulated net profits, bear no withholding tax at source. Where a foreign shareholder's bank requires proof of exemption, the registered agent shall issue a certified Certificate of Tax Exempt Status accompanied by a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax applies to interest and royalty payments by an IC to non-residents; treaty rates are not applicable due to the absence of bilateral DTA coverage. Returns of capital, share premium reductions, and liquidation distributions are likewise non-taxable in Vanuatu.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 — no statutory transfer pricing regime; no Local File or Master File obligations are imposed on Vanuatu International Companies. Nevertheless, under Section 43 of the International Companies Act, the IC must maintain intercompany invoices, general ledgers, and bank records sufficient to disclose the true financial position and must keep such records for at least 7 years at the registered agent's address or at another disclosed location.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation. For controlled transactions the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines are generally referenced: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, and Profit Split.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations equivalent to the BVI or Seychelles models. Under the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices monitoring, Vanuatu applies light-touch substance requirements: appointment of a registered agent, maintenance of a registered office in Port Vila, compliance with the AML/CFT beneficial ownership register, and annual return filing. A pure online retail IC with no employees, office, or physical presence in Vanuatu is not carrying on a 'relevant activity' (banking, shipping, financing, distribution, IP holding, or service centre), and therefore faces no additional economic substance mandates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying export records to claim zero-rated VAT treatment on hydroponics equipment, understating customs duty on embedded electronic controllers, or misrepresenting to a foreign tax authority that the IC is a Vanuatu tax resident while management and control remain in the market country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Value Added Tax Act, evaded VAT is recoverable with penalties up to 200% of the tax; the Customs Act applies fines up to VUV 2,000,000; false declarations in company filings attract a fine up to VUV 5,000,000 under the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false tax or registration declarations are liable to imprisonment up to 3 years, asset confiscation, and civil restitution. The Supreme Court may impose a travel ban pending fraud proceedings, and directors may be personally barred from managing any Vanuatu-licensed company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse and Veil Piercing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as a letterbox shell while the e-commerce business is functionally operated from another jurisdiction, appointing purely nominee directors who exercise no oversight, concealing true beneficial owners, and holding hidden operational assets outside Vanuatu to evade foreign tax enforcement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may strike the company off the register and impose a restoration penalty of VUV 50,000; in egregious cases the Supreme Court may order winding-up, forfeiture of the IC's domain name and payment-channel accounts, and deregistration of the local agent. Foreign revenue authorities may treat the IC as sham and deny the zero-tax status retroactively.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the company is a mere façade, courts will pierce the veil: directors are personally liable for the obligations of the online retail business, including customer refunds, supplier claims, and foreign tax assessments. Personal fines, asset restraint orders, and extradition on tax-fraud charges also apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Stripe or PayPal payments without performing customer due diligence, failing to maintain the beneficial ownership register with the registered agent, or using the IC's corporate bank account to launder proceeds from gardening-industry fraud, sanctioned jurisdictions, or cryptocurrency scams.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act, a body corporate is liable to fines up to VUV 100,000,000; the underlying transaction is voidable; the VFSC may suspend the registered agent's licence. Money laundering is punishable by imprisonment up to 20 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally prosecuted for money laundering where wilful blindness is proven; personal fines up to VUV 50,000,000, forfeiture of personal assets, 10-year disqualification from acting as a director of any Vanuatu company, and detention or travel bans pending trial are authorised sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Local Market Infringement and Unlicensed Retail in Vanuatu
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling hydroponics equipment to Vanuatu residents through any physical or digital channel, engaging in intra-Efate deliveries, or operating a domestic point-of-sale gateway without converting the entity into a local tax-paying company. International Companies are prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents by their offshore licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Section 53 of the International Companies Act provides that an IC carrying on business with Vanuatu residents commits an offence punishable by a fine up to VUV 1,000,000, compulsory deregistration, and unenforceability of all local contracts entered by the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are civilly liable to local creditors and third parties on the basis of breach of statutory warranty; the Supreme Court may issue a travel ban preventing directors from departing Vanuatu pending resolution, and on conviction directors may face imprisonment up to 2 years plus restitution orders.
